errors.reason: Terminal receipt and exact summary are required before accounting or text extraction. Full unchanged remaining finalization and runtime/stage validators precede packaging. Extra requests, altered artifact hashes, unaccounted stages, changed own history and wrong source fail closed. Missing/partial/failed finals are explicitly diagnostic or unavailable and never replaced by a draft.

Prior completion UBS E D0 is validated under its original completion runtime, kept exact by reference and excluded from new request count; L/C drafts remain same-run. Five remaining stage slots and six historical plus at most five new requests remain private but fully accounted. Original r2 rubric and visible_final_evidence helpers remain unchanged and no old global is patched.

paper_topic.reason: Exact raw final claims, own prior text and only actually supplied final-visible evidence support source interpretation, stated reason and allocation review. Conditions, paths, exposure timing labels, prior audit findings, role amendment and derived portfolios stay in private mapping. Opaque randomized items preserve partial masking and no ranking, human independence, causal effect or investment performance conclusion is claimed.

checked_boundaries: Read complete current production source, its minimal diff from unchanged completion builder, exact final-visible evidence helper and complete24-test source.
Metadata-only terminal_guard precedes remaining.finalize_remaining and all model text reading; no actual builder invocation was performed.
Explicit validator argument routes only carried E D0 to completion.validate_stage, avoiding mutable imported-module globals.
Actual saved own-D0 text and prepared messages must match the new final history; final source packet identity is verified.
Output and private trees are fresh and separated from all current/historical raw trees and private reports; source refs are rehashed before output creation and again before completion marker.
Judge item IDs use uuid4, order uses SystemRandom shuffle; private mapping retains true case order separately.
Raw outputs may themselves reveal condition, and controls visibly lack institutional evidence; masking is deliberately described as incomplete.
Unattempted final evidence is not represented as supplied; a recorded request with partial output carries explicit consumption uncertainty.

limitations: Static reading and author-run synthetic evidence do not prove future actual terminal integration.
Three final slots retain one same-input E/L pair and a shared C; they are not three independent replications.
